findings.title: Journal page has no way to retry after the entries fail to load
findings.expected: After a failed load, the error has a Retry / Try again control so the feed can be reloaded once the server recovers
findings.actual: Only the error text 'Injected 500' shows; the page has no retry button, so the user must reload the page or change the search to get the feed back

findings.title: Plant detail journal shows a load error with no way to retry
findings.expected: A Retry control next to the 'could not load the journal' error
findings.actual: The Journal section shows only the error and the 'Add entry' form; the entry list cannot be reloaded without reloading the page

findings.title: Malformed journal response is rendered as a list of blank entries instead of an error
findings.expected: A non-list response is reported as 'Could not load the journal'
findings.actual: The page says '14 entries' and renders 14 empty cards showing only '–', with no error
